"""Models of the API and their enums."""

from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder
from django.db import models


class OrderStatus(models.TextChoices):
    """Values of OrderStatus."""

    PENDING = "pending", "pending"
    PAID = "paid", "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped", "shipped"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled", "cancelled"


class Customer(models.Model):
    """A stored customer."""

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    name = models.TextField()
    email = models.TextField()
    password = models.TextField()
    phone = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    address = models.JSONField(encoder=DjangoJSONEncoder)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "customers"
        ordering = ["id"]


class Product(models.Model):
    """A stored product."""

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    sku = models.TextField()
    name = models.TextField()
    description = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    price = models.FloatField()
    stock = models.FloatField()
    active = models.BooleanField()

    class Meta:
        db_table = "products"
        ordering = ["id"]


class Order(models.Model):
    """A stored order."""

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    customer = models.ForeignKey("api.Customer", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="+")
    lines = models.JSONField(encoder=DjangoJSONEncoder)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=9, choices=OrderStatus.choices)
    total = models.FloatField()
    notes = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "orders"
        ordering = ["id"]

"""Serializers of the API: requests in, responses out."""

from api.models import Customer, OrderStatus
from config.validation import StrictSerializer
from rest_framework import serializers


class AddressSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """Address, embedded in the resources that hold it."""

    street = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    city = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    postalCode = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    country = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)


class OrderLineSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """OrderLine, embedded in the resources that hold it."""

    productId = serializers.IntegerField(required=True)
    quantity = serializers.FloatField(required=True)
    unitPrice = serializers.FloatField(required=True)


class CustomerSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """A customer: what a request may send and what a response shows."""

    id = serializers.ReadOnlyField()
    name = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    email = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    password = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True, required=True)
    phone = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=False)
    address = AddressSerializer(required=True)
    createdAt = serializers.DateTimeField(source="created_at", read_only=True)


class ProductSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """A product: what a request may send and what a response shows."""

    id = serializers.ReadOnlyField()
    sku = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    name = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=True)
    description = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=False)
    price = serializers.FloatField(required=True)
    stock = serializers.FloatField(required=True)
    active = serializers.BooleanField(required=True)


class OrderSerializer(StrictSerializer):
    """An order: what a request may send and what a response shows."""

    id = serializers.ReadOnlyField()
    customerId = serializers.PrimaryKeyRelatedField(queryset=Customer.objects.all(), source="customer", required=True)
    lines = OrderLineSerializer(many=True, required=True)
    status = serializers.ChoiceField(choices=OrderStatus.choices, required=True)
    total = serializers.FloatField(required=True)
    notes = serializers.CharField(trim_whitespace=False, allow_blank=True, required=False, allow_null=True)
    createdAt = serializers.DateTimeField(source="created_at", read_only=True)
    updatedAt = serializers.DateTimeField(source="updated_at", read_only=True)

"""Settings of the API. Everything secret comes from the environment: see .env.example."""

import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path

import dj_database_url

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

# Without DJANGO_SECRET_KEY a random key is used: fine to try the API, set your own before deploying it
SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get("DJANGO_SECRET_KEY") or secrets.token_urlsafe(50)
DEBUG = os.environ.get("DJANGO_DEBUG", "false").lower() == "true"
ALLOWED_HOSTS = [host.strip() for host in os.environ.get("DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS", "localhost,127.0.0.1").split(",") if host.strip()]

INSTALLED_APPS = [
    "django.contrib.contenttypes",
    "django.contrib.auth",
    "rest_framework",
    "api",
]

MIDDLEWARE = [
    "django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware",
    "django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware",
]

# Paths have no trailing slash, as openapi.yaml describes them
APPEND_SLASH = False
ROOT_URLCONF = "config.urls"
WSGI_APPLICATION = "config.wsgi.application"

# DATABASE_URL, for example postgres://user:password@host:5432/name; TEST_DATABASE_URL replaces it in the tests
DATABASES = {
    "default": dj_database_url.parse(os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL") or os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///db.sqlite3")),
}
DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD = "django.db.models.BigAutoField"

USE_TZ = True
TIME_ZONE = "UTC"

REST_FRAMEWORK = {
    "EXCEPTION_HANDLER": "config.errors.exception_handler",
    "DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES": [],
    "DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES": ["rest_framework.permissions.AllowAny"],
    "UNAUTHENTICATED_USER": None,

# shop-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Django REST Framework. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Python 3.12 or later.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate        # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
export $(grep -v "^#" .env | xargs)   # after copying .env.example to .env and filling it in
python manage.py makemigrations
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver
```

The API listens on http://localhost:8000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`. The first `makemigrations` writes the migrations of the models; keep them in your repository.

## Test it

```bash
python manage.py test
```

The tests create their own database (set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` to use a running server).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/customers` | List customers | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | Get a customer | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/customers` | Create a customer | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/customers/{id}` | Replace a customer | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/customers/{id}` | Update part of a customer | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/customers/{id}` | Delete a customer | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/products/{id}` | Get a product | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/products/{id}` | Replace a product | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | Update part of a product | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{id}` | Delete a product | 204 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders` | List orders | 200 | public |
| `GET` | `/orders/{id}` | Get an order | 200 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders` | Create an order | 201 | public |
| `PUT` | `/orders/{id}` | Replace an order | 200 | public |
| `PATCH` | `/orders/{id}` | Update part of an order | 200 | public |
| `DELETE` | `/orders/{id}` | Delete an order | 204 | public |
| `POST` | `/orders/{id}/action` | Business operation | 200 | public |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Django ORM on sqlite. A reference to another resource is a foreign key that protects it: deleting an item others refer to answers 409. Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON fields.

## Authentication

Every endpoint is public.

## Structure

```text
config/                settings, URLs, errors, authentication
api/                   models, serializers, services, views and URLs
tests/                 one test file per resource
openapi.yaml           the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- `POST /orders/{id}/action` (Business operation): write its logic in the service; it answers 501 until then.

"""Tests of the customers endpoints."""


from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from tests.helpers import TEST_SETTINGS, authorize, create_customer, customer_payload


@TEST_SETTINGS
class CustomersTests(APITestCase):
    """Every test starts with an empty database and a client allowed to call every endpoint."""

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        authorize(self.client)

    def test_create_customer(self) -> None:
        payload = customer_payload(self.client)
        response = self.client.post("/customers", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.content)
        created = response.json()
        self.assertIsNotNone(created["id"])
        self.assertEqual(created["name"], payload["name"])
        self.assertEqual(created["email"], payload["email"])
        self.assertEqual(created["phone"], payload["phone"])

    def test_create_customer_without_name(self) -> None:
        payload = customer_payload(self.client)
        del payload["name"]
        response = self.client.post("/customers", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        error = response.json()["error"]
        self.assertEqual(error["code"], "validation_error")
        self.assertTrue(any(detail["field"] == "name" for detail in error["details"]))

    def test_get_customer(self) -> None:
        created = create_customer(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.get(f"/customers/{key}")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json(), created)

    def test_get_missing_customer(self) -> None:
        response = self.client.get("/customers/999999")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["error"]["code"], "not_found")

    def test_list_customers(self) -> None:
        create_customer(self.client)
        create_customer(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.get("/customers")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["page"], 1)

    def test_list_customers_by_page(self) -> None:
        create_customer(self.client)
        create_customer(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.get("/customers", {"page": 2, "size": 1})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(response.json()["items"]), 1)

    def test_list_customers_rejects_a_bad_page(self) -> None:
        response = self.client.get("/customers", {"page": 0})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_replace_customer(self) -> None:
        created = create_customer(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        payload = customer_payload(self.client, variant=1)
        response = self.client.put(f"/customers/{key}", payload, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], payload["name"])
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["email"], payload["email"])
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["phone"], payload["phone"])

    def test_update_customer(self) -> None:
        created = create_customer(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.patch(f"/customers/{key}", {"name": "name 2"}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["name"], "name 2")

    def test_update_customer_rejects_null(self) -> None:
        created = create_customer(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.patch(f"/customers/{key}", {"name": None}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_delete_customer(self) -> None:
        created = create_customer(self.client)
        key = created["id"]
        response = self.client.delete(f"/customers/{key}")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 204, response.content)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(f"/customers/{key}").status_code, 404)
